Introducing: Jasmine Marsters, NZ Strongman

11 June 2026Share

Welcome to our Ambassador blog series, where we celebrate the diverse passions and pursuits of ordinary Kiwis achieving the extraordinary. From athletes to artists and everything in between, they embody the spirit of New Zealand through their shared love for their respective sports, activities, passions and occupations.

Join us in discovering their inspiring stories.

15. Jasmine Marsters, NZ Strongman competitor

1. Who are you? Your background, occupation and where you are based.

My name is Jasmine Marsters. I am half Cook Island, half Tongan, born and raised in South Auckland, and blessed with six beautiful kids.

2. What is your sport or passion, what drew you to it, and what are the pros and cons?

I compete in strongman, and now, thanks to my eldest daughter, I have recently started learning to play rugby alongside her.

Needing to be strong, not only physically but also mentally, is what attracted me to it. I love it because all I wanted growing up with my brothers was to be as strong as them, and this was a way for me to prove it.

The pros for me are that you get to meet a lot of amazing people, all supporting one another as they put in the work to get the job done. The con for me is that it takes a toll on the body, so listen to it and look after it.

All I wanted growing up with my brothers was to be as strong as them.

3. What is your biggest achievement to date, and what is your ultimate goal?

My biggest achievement to date has to be my overhead strength gains. Going from not being able to get a 20 kg bar over my head to now being able to overhead press 75 kg is a big achievement for me.

My ultimate goal is to hit the numbers I set for myself when I started my strongman journey, and one day, if I am able to, compete in an overseas competition.

4. How does X-ZONE help?

It was by chance that I got to see Jess at this year's Strongman Series Easter Show, on day 2 of the competition. She was kind enough to let me try the X-ZONE Sports Rub, which honestly helped me out. The instant relief I felt was unbelievable. Ever since then I've been hooked, and it's now a part of my training and recovery routine.

Find out more about NZ Strongman: newzealandstrongman.co.nz

Introducing: Mollie Allison, NZ Beach Volleyball

27 May 2026Share

Welcome to our Ambassador blog series, where we celebrate the diverse passions and pursuits of ordinary Kiwis achieving the extraordinary. From athletes to artists and everything in between, they embody the spirit of New Zealand through their shared love for their respective sports, activities, passions and occupations.

Join us in discovering their inspiring stories.

14. Mollie Allison, NZ beach volleyball representative

1. Who are you? Your background, occupation and where you are based.

I'm Mollie Allison and I am currently studying for my Postgraduate Diploma in Clinical Exercise Physiology. I am based in Hamilton, and in my spare time I coach volleyball and beach volleyball to all ages, from 5-year-olds to adults.

2. What is your sport or passion, what drew you to it, and what are the pros and cons?

I currently represent New Zealand in beach volleyball as part of the NZA squad, as well as playing competitive indoor volleyball during the winter. I love spending all my time on the courts, training hard myself but also giving back and teaching all I know to those around me.

A big pro of playing beach volleyball is being able to train outdoors and at beaches. A big con is not having many people to train with in my area, as well as everything being largely self-funded.

Training hard myself, but also giving back and teaching all I know to those around me.

3. What is your biggest achievement to date, and what is your ultimate goal?

My biggest achievements to date would be representing NZ in America and Australia, and consistently making the top 5 on the New Zealand Beach Tour at a young age.

My ultimate goal is to be part of New Zealand's top partnership and represent all over the world.

4. How does X-ZONE help?

X-ZONE will help me with my performance and to achieve my goals by managing muscle soreness, warming up effectively, recovering better and staying consistent through high-intensity training.

Find out more about NZ beach volleyball: www.volleyballnz.org.nz
